messages:
Priya Patel: Customer on Dedicated hit a parse error — streaming response is getting cut off mid-JSON. They see JSONDecodeError in prod. Sharing logs and a minimal repro I asked for.

Priya Patel: Customer excerpt (from their app):
```
{ "id": "abc123", "result": { "text": "Hello, world", "meta": {"score": 0.92}
```
(truncated)

Matt (support-engineer): Thanks — can you paste the exact request they used (headers, model, stream flag) and any proxy in front of them?

Priya Patel: Curl they used (sanitized):
```bash
curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -d '{"model":"rw-infer-large","stream":true,"structured_output":"json","input":"Summarize..."}'
```
Their client shows chunked responses like: 
```
data: {"id":"abc123","chunk":{"text":"Hello, ","is_final":false}}\n

data: {"id":"abc123","chunk":{"text":"world","is_final":false}}\n

data: {"id":"abc123","chunk":{"text":"\n\"meta\":{\"score\":0.92}\n"  // then connection closes here
```

Matt (support-engineer): Do our ingress logs show any 5xx or connection resets? Which backend pool were they routed to?

runtime-bot: New log entries for trace 0a9f3b4d - client_closed_before_end (499) - route: rw-dedicated-us-west-2-pool-7 - duration_ms: 11830

Rohit (eng-runtime): 499 suggests client closed. Two possibilities we should look into: 1) client read-timeout or proxy dropping idle stream; 2) our worker hit a hard timeout while flushing final frame. Also chunk boundary handling for structured JSON sometimes interleaves meta which confuses naive parsers.

Jared Lee: Immediate mitigation for customers: 1) ask them to call non-streaming (stream=false) for critical JSON parsing; 2) bump client read timeout and enable reconnect logic; 3) add a simple framing layer on the client side (wait until matching braces OR rely on an end sentinel). Example: wait for final event with "is_final":true.

Matt (support-engineer): I repro'd locally with `rw-infer-large` using the same streaming flag. The server emitted the final chunk but the connection closed before client ack on my dev env when I artificially set client timeout to 4s. If I increase to 30s it completes fine. Attaching my quick repro steps and trace: trace=0a9f3b4d-local.

Rohit (eng-runtime): Action items:
- [ ] Add explicit finalizer token for structured JSON streams (e.g. `{"__redwood_stream_end__":true}`) to make parsing robust server-side and client-side. (owner: Rohit)
- [ ] Add server-side safety to ensure final flush always sent before closing connection, and log if close happens with partial structured output. (owner: eng-runtime)
- [ ] Support ticket reply with workaround + ask customer to increase client timeout. (owner: Priya)
- [ ] Postmortem checklist if we see repeated 499s for this pool. (owner: Jared)

Rohit (eng-runtime): Tentative plan: add sentinel in staging by EOD, run quick canary against Dedicated pool, then rollout. Also add a small change to ingress to mark streams with structured_output and extend idle keepalive to avoid proxy kills.

Priya Patel: I'll send customer this workaround and ETA. Also letting them know a patch is planned and asking for logs if they have any proxy between app and our API.

Jared Lee: Note — long-term we should document best practices for JSON-mode + streaming in the docs (parser patterns, sentinel, or use non-stream for strict schema). I'll open a docs ticket.

Matt (support-engineer): For immediate triage: replied to customer with steps (non-stream option + increase read timeout) and asked if they can test within the hour. Marking this as P1 until we confirm stable behavior. :thumbsup:

Priya Patel: Updating ticket and will post back here with customer confirmation or more logs.
